==Description==
'''Cherry Bomb''' Will be an entity very common in the '''Super Epic Mode''' Game mode. With the aim of blowing up the lockers/cabinets in the room

==Mechanics==
'''Cherry Bomb''' will spawn 
no the middle of the room, with a sound of time bomb, after some seconds it will explode, breaking all lockers in the room he was.

==Strategies==
Hide when it spawns or just get out of the sight.

==Trivia==
Cherry Bomb before would say "Cherry Bomb!" before exploding, but the audio was deleted.
